caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the Average Speech Recognition (ASR) score for four different triggers – start, random, end, and athletics – across a range of media organizations. The x-axis represents the names of these organizations, labeled as cf, bb, WNBA, ESPN, NHL, FIFA, and Estadio, and is displayed on a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.6 to 0.9, with tick intervals of one organization. The y-axis represents the ASR score, ranging from approximately 0.6 to 0.9, with tick intervals of 0.1. The ‘start’ trigger is represented by a solid orange line beginning at approximately 0.63 and declining to around 0.53. The ‘random’ trigger is indicated by a dashed red line initially at approximately 0.55, decreasing to approximately 0.48. The ‘end’ trigger is shown by a solid purple line commencing at approximately 0.58, then increasing to around 0.83. Finally, the ‘athletics’ trigger is denoted by a solid blue line that begins at approximately 0.8, declining to approximately 0.78.
